item.title: Cache Tech Community Meetup - September 2026
item.description: Join us on Saturday, September 26th, 2026 for Intro to How LLMs Work, an introduction to what’s actually going on inside a large language model. We’ll cover the vocabulary — tokens, parameters, dimensions, transformers — with a focus on the GPT-2 architecture. No machine learning background required!
